item.title: Scientists use AI to track permafrost thaw as Arctic lakes vanish in hours
item.description: A new near-real-time monitoring tool has detected 30 additional drained lakes in northwestern Alaska since June 2026.

item.title: Why the Fed is often slow, late, and wrong in reading inflation
item.description: The central bank should focus more on short-term trends that may indicate an important 'inflation regime change' is already underway.

item.title: At 55, I became a rookie teacher after 3 decades in tech PR. Gen Z is teaching me a lot and reminding me to trust myself
item.description: In a world of negative news and shifting opportunities, Gen Z often shows radical self-trust and quiet, solid confidence.

item.title: AI job losses lower than predicted: only 3% of workers affected
item.description: A national poll of 1,250 employed adults found 6% gained AI-created roles and 9% received AI-linked promotions between 2023 and 2024.
